about_the_game:
Golden Steam is an electrifying fusion of arcade action and mind-bending puzzles, set in a world where time itself is fractured. As a daring adventurer, you must collect the elusive Golden Steams and power up the intricate gears of a mysterious machine. Only by recovering scattered artifacts from different eras—lost and warped by the flow of negative time—can you piece together the ultimate relic to unlock the game’s final, awe-inspiring secret.

Traverse 10 diverse worlds, each packed with 10 challenging levels, where precision and quick thinking are your greatest allies. Master the rotation of enigmatic geometric shapes and manipulate the fragile balance of time to overcome obstacles that defy reality.

For those craving endless thrills, Golden Steam offers an intense arcade mode with an ever-growing leaderboard—put your skills to the test in a relentless race against time and entropy.

Step into a universe where science fiction meets steampunk, and every second counts in your quest to reclaim what time has stolen.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 (dual/quad 3.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Golden Steam is a thrilling arcade-puzzle adventure where you collect Golden Steams and activate machine parts to recover artifacts scattered through fractured time. Navigate 10 worlds, master geometric rotations, and control time itself in a steampunk sci-fi universe where every second counts.
